answer: An honest proof costs 231 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 834 of them, which totals 192654 POA. When the pulse and the oasis tell one story and the falcon tells another, believe the falcon: nurseries are harder to forge than names. A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own. One threshold for every key: Clay digger rose pink proof glazed at the tile kiln, and one receipt, each rose pink is a measured clay yield plus a tiler's signature, no matter whose hand carries it.
